title: BC Cancer + Provincial Health Services Authority
source_title: New Surrey Hospital & Cancer Centre, Appendix 1R: Wayfinding Standards & Requirements
method: Copied all 41 original MuPDF SVG path nodes in their source drawing order without editing path data or original transforms; added only a coordinate translation to origin. Nodes were identified by unique BC Cancer fill colours and validated against 41 bounded PDF drawing records. The only original ancestor was a whole-page clip. No autotracing, shape rebuilding, recolouring or font replacement.
colours_note: The PDF export renders purple as #9361a9, one RGB step different from #9361a8 in the standalone research-site SVG. Original source-specific values are retained. Pantone/CMYK labels on this page are separate brand-colour evidence.

verification.visual_review: Rendered SVG and PDF source crop examined at 1016 x 680 pixels; all lettering and logo shapes intact, no extraneous page elements. Binary alpha-mask intersection over union is 99.7901%; small antialiasing differences occur between Inkscape and MuPDF renderers.
